Thesis vs hygiene

A good story — but is there a reason to refuse?

9 chapters with worked investigations

01Thesis vs hygiene02Immediate rug risk03Slow extraction04Organic slow death05The self rug06Token cycle, meta cycle & attention07Due diligence keeps moving08Clear decision states09The basic dev view

01Definition

Thesis asks why demand could grow. Hygiene asks what can disqualify the token. Keep the two decisions separate.

02Why it matters

More upside evidence cannot cancel a severe structural failure.

03What to check

  • Magnitude + velocity: reach and pace of credible attention
  • Retention + renewal: persistence and the next catalyst
  • Meta fit and independently verified hygiene

04Healthy / Dangerous

Healthy

The thesis and the hygiene checks have separate evidence.

Dangerous

Excitement excuses a failed check or fills an evidence gap.

05Beginner mistake

Calling a polished website proof of safety.

06Takeaway

A strong thesis cannot cancel failed hygiene.

Thesis: magnitude → velocity → retention → renewal → meta fit.

Hygiene remains a separate gate. Critical unknowns stay unresolved.

ILLUSTRATIVE · NOT A LIVE TOKEN

See the idea

  1. 01

    A meme attracts credible discussion and new buyers.

  2. 02

  3. 03

WORKED INVESTIGATION · ILLUSTRATIVE

Work through the evidence

Mechanism and worked case

A story and a tradable token are separate claims. A credible event may attract attention, while the exact contract still has a controller who can freeze accounts. A strong story cannot compensate for an exit that fails.

How to investigate it

Make two columns. In thesis, record the primary event source, date, exact-contract association, and evidence that buyers return. In hygiene, record permissions, ordinary-wallet sales, liquidity control, and related inventory. Put unknowns in the appropriate column rather than giving the token one blended grade.

Check your reasoning — answered

A token has rising attention and confirmed ordinary-wallet sales, but its liquidity controller is unknown. Is hygiene cleared? No: successful sales answer current selling ability, not who can withdraw the pool. Keep the controller question unresolved.

Trace it externally

Verify current permissions, sell restrictions, and liquidity control with chain-specific explorers and security tools. Meme Fast does not issue a hygiene clearance.

Go deeper

Magnitude asks how far a narrative could spread, not how many posts already exist. Velocity asks how fast credible participation changes. Retention asks what survives the burst; renewal asks what creates another reason to participate. Meta fit asks whether the wider theme still attracts demand. These are research questions, not a score or a Container sizing formula. Assess X history, website claims, community independence, and actual buyers alongside them.
